description: Hand-edited manufacturer anchors for the Turbo Timber Evolution 1.5 m, B revision (EFL105250B). Values and page numbers come from docs/research/timber-integration/TT-00/sources.md; the manual itself is not in the repository. build_geometry.py reads this file; every number keeps its kind and source.

hardware_revision.value: EFL105250B / EFL105275B (2024 B revision: 70 A Avian Smart Lite ESC, heavier gear springs)
hardware_revision.source: TT-00 sources.md, Horizon Hobby product pages; the r1 mesh revision is unconfirmed by its author

length_m.source: EFL105250B manual p.3 (1,040 mm); measurement endpoints not stated

mass_empty_kg.source: EFL105250B manual p.3 (1,860 g without battery)

mass_flying_kg.source: EFL105250B manual p.3 (2,190 g with the recommended 4S 3,200 mAh pack)

cg_aft_of_root_le_m.source: EFL105250B manual p.13: 60 +/- 5 mm aft of the wing-root leading edge, slats off

throws_mm.source: EFL105250B manual p.14 (quick-start setup): linear trailing-edge travel from neutral, symmetric up/down; the flap settings carry 16 %/30 % down-elevator mixes that are setup values, not geometry

throw_measurement.convention: straight-line distance between the neutral and deflected trailing-edge positions, d = 2 r sin(theta / 2), r = perpendicular distance from the hinge axis to the trailing edge at the station

stations.aileron: inboard end of the aileron (first clean slice outboard of its inner edge)
stations.elevator: elevator root beside the fuselage (first clean stabilizer slice)
stations.rudder: aft-most rudder vertex (the rudder chord is constant)
stations.flap: inboard end of the flap (first clean slice outboard of the wing root)

throw_measurement.source: the manual states millimetres but not the spanwise station; E-flite setup sheets measure at the widest point of the surface next to the fuselage. Angles over the whole span are reported as a range so the assumption stays visible

propeller.source: EFL105250B manual p.13 and Horizon part EFL5962

servos.value: six 9 g metal-gear servos (2 ailerons, 2 flaps, elevator, rudder)
